statement: Delaware stock is issued under board authority: the board may authorize issuance for cash, tangible or intangible property, or any benefit to the corporation, in one or more transactions, in the numbers, at the times, and for the consideration set forth in its resolution, and par-value shares must be issued for consideration worth at least par value (8 Del. C. § 152(a), § 153(a)).
caveat: Stock issued without board authorization or below par raises defective-corporate-act problems (cured, if at all, under §§ 204-205). The authorized-share ceiling in the charter binds the board. This repo does not validate a specific issuance.
